title: Movie Search
description: Build a movie search and filter system with case-insensitive title search, genre filtering, rating sorting, and combined queries.

steps.title: Movie data array
steps.description: Create an array of movie objects with `title`, `year`, `genre`, and `rating` properties. Include at least 4 movies.
hints: Use different genres like Action, Comedy, Drama
Include varied years for realistic data

codeTemplate.python:
movies = [
    # Your code here - at least 4 movies
]
import json
print(json.dumps(movies))

verification.failureMessage: Include title, year, genre, and rating for at least 4 movies.

steps.title: searchByTitle function
steps.description: Write `searchByTitle(movies, query)` that returns movies whose title contains the query string (case-insensitive).
hints: Convert both title and query to lowercase

verification.failureMessage: Return movies whose title contains the query (case-insensitive).

steps.title: filterByGenre function
steps.description: Write `filterByGenre(movies, genre)` that returns movies matching the given genre (case-insensitive).
hints: Compare movie.genre with the filter value

verification.failureMessage: Return only movies that match the genre.

steps.title: sortByRating function
steps.description: Write `sortByRating(movies, order)` that sorts movies by rating. `order` is `'asc'` or `'desc'`.

verification.failureMessage: Sort movies by rating in the specified order.

steps.title: Combined search + filter + sort
steps.description: Write `queryMovies(movies, options)` that combines title search, genre filter, and rating sort in a single function.
hints: Accept { query, genre, sortOrder } as options
Skip steps where criteria is empty or null
